# Paintings by Mery (paintingsuae.com)

> Official website of Mery Zakkak, a painter based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. She sells original paintings (acrylic, fluid art and mixed media on canvas and wood), takes commissions, offers studio visits in Abu Dhabi, and runs art workshops for kids and adults, including a 12-week creative art expression course and seasonal vision board workshops (in person in Abu Dhabi and live online).

## Key facts
- Artist: Mery Zakkak. Moved from Lebanon to the UAE in 2018; painting became her way of coping with change, which led to her memoir "Art as My Therapy".
- Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
- Portfolio: 66 works across 12 series; 44 currently available, priced from AED 50 to AED 4,500.
- Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 338 0577, email merycreativejourney@gmail.com, Instagram @paintings.bymery and @merycreativejourney.
- Press: UAE Stories, "Mery Zakkak transforming creativity" (https://uaestories.com/mery-zakkak-transforming-creativity/).

## Pages
- [Home](https://paintingsuae.com/): artist story, series, workshops and contact.
- [Gallery](https://paintingsuae.com/gallery): every painting with size, medium, price and availability.
- [Vision board workshop, 5 December 2026](https://paintingsuae.com/new-year-new-you/): "New Year, New You", 2 hours, Abu Dhabi AED 250 or online AED 150.
- [Beyond the canvas](https://paintingsuae.com/beyond): painted objects and creative projects.
- [Art as My Therapy (free memoir, PDF)](https://paintingsuae.com/art-as-my-therapy.pdf)
